summary: Gone log and frame cabin on Stevens Peak in the Kootenai National Forest near Noxon, dated 1930 and abandoned 1948; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FireLookout.com says abandoned 1948 and gone; Forest Lookouts lists it as removed

events.note: FireLookout.com dates the log and frame cabin to 1930; no second source read gives a build date

evidence.supports: log and frame cabin dated 1930, abandoned 1948, gone
about five miles south of Noxon in Sanders County
location code 25N-32W-18 within Kootenai National Forest

notes_for_editor: Only two short lookout pages and the FFLA list; the 1930 build date rests on FireLookout.com alone. Forest Lookouts gives no dates and only the word Removed. Do not attach the 1930 ready-cut lookout houses named on the Big Hole page (Squaw Peak in the Noxon district and others) to Stevens Peak; that page does not name Stevens. No source describes the site today.
